name: Can I stay in my home while custom kitchen cabinets are being installed?

mainEntity.name: Can I stay in my home while custom kitchen cabinets are being installed?

acceptedAnswer.text:
A cabinet-only project can sometimes be completed while keeping the existing layout, but a full kitchen remodel usually causes temporary disruption. The biggest factors are sink and appliance disconnection, demolition, flooring, utility work, inspections, countertops, and cabinet delivery.

Context: Trying to keep a kitchen operating can influence sequencing and may increase labor or temporary protection needs. Elite Remodeling & Design can plan the work around the actual project scope rather than assuming every remodel follows the same schedule.

Key factors:
- Whether the sink and refrigerator can remain connected
- Number of construction stages
- Availability of a temporary food-preparation area
- Dust, noise, and access restrictions

Practical guidance: Ask for a phase-by-phase plan and prepare a temporary kitchen with water, refrigeration, and safe food storage. Confirm how the work area will be protected and cleaned each day.

Planning household logistics early makes the disruption easier to manage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Often, but expect disruption if the sink, appliances, flooring, utilities, or countertops are involved. Ask for a phase-by-phase schedule, prepare a temporary food area, and confirm daily protection and cleanup procedures.
